people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
translations.bsb: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own. Ephraim has hired lovers.
translations.kjv: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
translations.asv: For they are gone up to Assyria, like a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
